Luggage

Know your Luggage limits - You may travel with no more than 3 items of luggage - a maximum of one suitcase (not exceeding 30x70x90cm), a small carry-on bag, and a handbag. Please don’t exceed these limits, as extra items will only be carried if there is available space on board, and excess charges may apply.
